description: Portfolio tracker kit. The complete portfolio-monitoring methodology: a two-segment memory layout, three intake routes, the never-invent-prices quote discipline, tiered alert thresholds, and the daily brief protocol, for stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, and crypto holdings. One call returns the full kit; the buyer's agent runs the tracking itself. Monitoring and alerts only, never advice. Price: $10.00 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.

portfolio.description: The portfolio the buyer's agent tracks with the kit, e.g. VTI, AAPL, BTC.
